name: Parcl
rootCause: The website frontend of Solana ecosystem real estate trading protocol Parcl has been hacked, extracting tokens from users' Solana wallets and displaying fake transaction results in Phantom. Parcl’s official X account also appears to have been compromised, posting information related to PARCL rewards.
